blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) depend fundamentally on the diversity, depth, and factual rigor of their pre-training corpora. However, contemporary foundational pre-training datasets (such as The Pile, S2ORC, and Dolma) exhibit a severe structural omission: African scientific, medical, legal, and agricultural scholarship constitutes less than 0.5% of global pre-training tokens. Consequently, state-of-the-art models suffer from systematic failure modes when reasoning about tropical epidemiology, localized smallholder agro-ecologies, regional economic governance, and indigenous linguistic structures. To resolve this representation deficit and advance African intellectual sovereignty in artificial intelligence, we introduce Africa-Papers, the largest curated multi-domain Pan-African academic pre-training corpus to date. Comprising over 844,807 full-text papers spanning 10.15 billion tokens across 879 Parquet shards, Africa-Papers unifies four primary scientific streams: (1) continental peer-reviewed journals indexed in DOAJ across 31 African nations, (2) the CGIAR CGSpace agricultural repository, (3) African-authored and African-focused STEM/AI preprints on arXiv, and (4) open-access international publications by scholars affiliated with African institutions indexed via OpenAlex. The entire corpus is processed into layout-aware, clean Markdown preserving section hierarchies, mathematical equations, and tabular data, accompanied by exact BPE token counts and a standardized 8-domain taxonomy. We release Africa-Papers openly on the Hugging Face Hub under the AfriSpeech organization to accelerate continual pre-training and domain evaluation for foundation models globally.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)从根本上取决于其训练前公司的多样性,深度和真实的刚性. 然而,当代基础培训前数据集(如The Pile、S2ORC和Dolma)显示出严重的结构性遗漏:非洲科学、医学、法律和农业奖学金占全球培训前标志的不到0.5%。 因此,在对热带流行病学、地方性小农农业生态学、区域经济治理和土著语言结构进行推理时,最先进的模型就受到系统失效模式的影响。 为了解决这种代表性不足和增进非洲在人工智能方面的知识主权,我们引进了非洲-帕珀斯,这是迄今为止规模最大的多领域泛非学术预培训书。 由844 807份涵盖879个Parquet shards的超过1015亿令牌的全文论文组成,非洲-Papers统一了四个主要科学流:(1) 由DOAJ索引的非洲同行评审期刊,覆盖31个非洲国家;(2) CGIAR CGSpace Agriculture;(3) 非洲作者和以非洲为重点的STEM/AI在arXiv上的预印本;以及(4) 与非洲机构有联系的学者通过OpenAlex索引的公开访问国际出版物。 整个元件被处理成布局意识,清洁的Markdown保存部分分级,数学方程,以及表格数据,并附有精确的BPE令牌计数和标准化的8域分类. 我们在非洲荷兰语组织下的Hugging Face Hub上公开发布非洲Papers,

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The dominant paradigm in training foundation language models relies on web-scale text corpora aggregated from web scrapes and digitized libraries [ 9 , 8 ] . While datasets such as Common Crawl, The Pile [ 3 ] , and peS2o [ 8 ] contain trillions of tokens, their geographic and institutional provenance is overwhelmingly skewed toward North America, Western Europe, and East Asia. Scholarship authored by African researchers and peer-reviewed journals published across the 54 African nations represent a negligible fraction ( < 0.5 % <0.5\% ) of the global academic pre-training mixture.
blocks.zh: 培训基础语言模型的主导范式依赖于从网络碎片和数字化库中汇总的网络规模文本corpora[9,8]. 虽然诸如Crowl、The Pile[3]和peS2o[8]等数据集包含着数万亿的代币,但其地理和体制来源却压倒性地向北美、西欧和东亚倾斜。 由非洲研究人员和在54个非洲国家出版的同行评审期刊撰写的奖学金占全球学术培训前混合物的微小部分( < 0.5% < 0.5%)。

blocks.en: This severe under-representation induces significant epistemological vulnerabilities in contemporary models: • Biomedical & Epidemiological Hallucinations: Foundational models frequently fail when reasoning about tropical pathologies (e.g., malaria strain variants, sickle cell genetics, lassa fever diagnostics, maternal healthcare delivery) because clinical training data defaults to Western institutional protocols [ 1 ] . • Agro-Ecological Misalignment: AI conversational assistants routinely default to temperate industrial monoculture recommendations, proving ineffective for African smallholders managing complex, climate-vulnerable intercropping of cassava, yams, cowpea, plantains, or sorghum. • Jurisprudential & Governance Gaps: African customary jurisprudence, community-based land tenure systems, and regional trade compacts (e.g., AfCFTA) are almost entirely missing from standard legal corpora. • Deficit Framing in Representation: Western web scrapes disproportionately depict the African continent through crisis reporting, humanitarian appeals, or conflict studies. Models therefore fail to internalize African scholars as primary intellectual authorities in astrophysics, pure mathematics, computer science, and robotics.
blocks.zh: 这种严重代表性不足的情况在当代模式中引起严重的流行病学脆弱性:生物医学和流行病学 幻觉:关于热带病变的推理(如疟疾菌株变种,镰状细胞遗传学,拉萨热诊断学,产妇保健分娩)时,基础模型经常失败,因为临床培训数据默认为西方机构协议[1]. • 农业生态学 错位 : 人工智能对话助理经常不提出温和的工业单一种植建议,事实证明,对于管理复杂、气候易变的木薯、红薯、黄豆、平原或高粱的非洲小农来说,这种建议是无效的。 • 司法审慎和治理 差距:标准法人几乎完全没有非洲习惯法判例、社区土地保有权制度以及区域贸易协定(如非洲自由贸易协定)。 • 代表性不足: 西方网络通过危机报告、人道主义呼吁或冲突研究,过度描绘非洲大陆。 因此,模型无法将非洲学者作为天体物理学、纯数学、计算机科学和机器人学领域的主要知识权威。

blocks.en: To systematically dismantle this structural omission, we present Africa-Papers , an open-access, layout-aware academic corpus engineered specifically for the pre-training and continual domain adaptation of foundation language models.
blocks.zh: 为了系统地消除这种结构上的遗漏,我们介绍了非洲-Papers,这是一个开放的、有意识的学术机构,专门为基础语言模型的预先培训和持续领域调整而设计的。

blocks.en: Contributions: 1. Massive Scale & Depth: Over 789,348 verified full-text papers yielding 10.15 billion tokens (and actively scaling toward 25 billion tokens across 1.5 million works), establishing the single largest curated African academic corpus in history. 2. Four-Pillar Multi-Source Architecture: We integrate continental university presses (DOAJ), agricultural field manuals (CGIAR), STEM and AI preprints (arXiv), and global African scholarly literature (OpenAlex). 3. High-Fidelity Markdown Ingestion: We develop an autonomous stream-to-parquet pipeline employing multi-key deduplication and layout-aware Markdown parsing, preserving tabular data, headings, and formulas while preventing disk bloat through real-time binary pruning. 4. Domain Taxonomy & Open Release: We classify the corpus into eight standardized academic domains and release the entire collection incrementally on Hugging Face under AfriSpeech/africa-papers 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/datasets/AfriSpeech/africa-papers .

blocks.en: 2 The Four Pillars of Africa-Papers
blocks.zh: 2 非洲的四大支柱

blocks.en: Africa-Papers is constructed through a federated multi-stream architecture designed to capture both research about Africa and research by African scientists across the globe.
blocks.zh: 非洲-Papers是通过一个联合多流结构建造的,旨在收集非洲方面的研究以及全球各地非洲科学家的研究。

blocks.en: 2.1 Pillar 1: DOAJ Continental Journal Presses
blocks.zh: 2.1 支柱1:DOAJ 大陆期刊出版社

blocks.en: To capture scholarship published domestically across African universities, we harvest the complete index of African journals registered in the Directory of Open Access Journals (DOAJ) [ 4 ] . This comprises extbf944 peer-reviewed journals spanning 31 African nations. These journals encompass university presses, national academies, and regional scholarly associations published in English, French, Arabic, and Portuguese. In total, 74,606 full-text PDFs were harvested from primary host servers.
blocks.zh: 为了获得非洲各大学在国内出版的奖学金,我们收集了《开放查阅期刊目录》中登记的非洲期刊的完整索引[4]。 这包括由31个非洲国家同行评审的期刊。 这些期刊包括以英文、法文、阿拉伯文和葡萄牙文出版的大学报刊、国家学院和区域学术协会。 从主机服务器总共收获了74 606份PDF全文。

blocks.en: 2.2 Pillar 2: CGIAR CGSpace Agricultural Repository
blocks.zh: 2.2 支柱2:农研组CGIAR空间农业仓库

blocks.en: Agricultural self-sufficiency and pest resilience represent existential priorities across Sub-Saharan Africa. We interface with extbfCGSpace [ 2 ] , the digital repository of the CGIAR consortium, hosting the research outputs of leading African agricultural centers: • IITA (International Institute of Tropical Agriculture, Ibadan, Nigeria) • ILRI (International Livestock Research Institute, Nairobi, Kenya & Addis Ababa, Ethiopia) • AfricaRice (Bouaké, Côte d’Ivoire) • ICRAF (World Agroforestry, Nairobi, Kenya) We filter for documents possessing verified bitstreams, extracting extbf50,534 full-text agricultural manuals, pest diagnostic guides (e.g., Fall Armyworm, Cassava Mosaic), soil maps, and extension treatises.
blocks.zh: 农业自给自足和虫害抗御能力是整个撒哈拉以南非洲存在的优先事项。 • IITA(国际热带农业研究所,尼日利亚伊巴丹) 我们过滤拥有经核实的位流的文件,提取exbf50,534全文的农业手册、病虫害诊断指南(如Fall Armydrom, Cassava Mosaic),土壤图和扩展论文。

blocks.en: IITA (International Institute of Tropical Agriculture, Ibadan, Nigeria)
blocks.zh: IITA(国际热带农业研究所,尼日利亚伊巴丹)

blocks.en: ILRI (International Livestock Research Institute, Nairobi, Kenya & Addis Ababa, Ethiopia)
blocks.zh: ILRI(国际牲畜研究所,肯尼亚内罗毕和埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴)

blocks.en: AfricaRice (Bouaké, Côte d’Ivoire)
blocks.zh: 非洲里塞(科特迪瓦布瓦凯)

blocks.en: ICRAF (World Agroforestry, Nairobi, Kenya)
blocks.zh: 农林中心(世界农林业,肯尼亚内罗毕)

blocks.en: 2.3 Pillar 3: African STEM & AI Preprints (arXiv)
blocks.zh: 2.3 支柱3:非洲STEM & AI Preprints(arXiv)

blocks.en: To capture high-velocity computational and physical science outputs, we analyze the entire 3.19-million-paper historical snapshot of arXiv. We isolate preprints meeting two criteria: (1) topical and keyword focus on African systems, languages, or geographic contexts, and (2) institutional affiliations situated within African universities. This yields extbf42,530 full-text preprints. Crucially, natural language processing ( cs.CL ) represents the single largest computational category (1,066 papers), capturing seminal foundational works on low-resource African speech, translation, and language modeling [ 5 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了获取高速度的计算和物理科学产出,我们分析了319万纸的ARXIV整个历史快照。 我们孤立了符合两项标准的预印:(1) 关注非洲系统、语言或地理背景的专题和关键词;(2) 位于非洲大学内的机构联系。 这个输出出exbf42,530全文预印. 关键是,自然语言处理(cs.CL)代表单一最大的计算类别(1,066篇论文),收录关于低资源非洲语音,翻译,语言模型的开创性基础作品[5,6].

blocks.en: 2.4 Pillar 4: Global African Scholar Open Access
blocks.zh: 2.4 支柱4:全球非洲学者开放访问

blocks.en: The majority of high-impact research produced by African scholars is published in international peer-reviewed journals (e.g., Nature, PLOS ONE, Lancet, Springer, IEEE) rather than local presses. We utilize the OpenAlex open academic graph [ 7 ] to query the global scholarly record for open-access works whose author affiliations originate from African institutions ( institutions.continent:africa, has_pdf_url:true ). We indexed a master catalog of extbf1,517,281 unique African papers with direct, validated PDF URLs, which are ingested through our streaming pipeline.
blocks.zh: 非洲学者制作的影响力大的研究大多发表在国际同行评审期刊上(如Nature,PLOS ONE,Lancet,Springer,IEEE),而不是当地报刊上. 我们利用OpenAlex开放学术图[7]来查询其作者来源于非洲机构的开放访问作品的全球学术记录。 我们用经过验证的PDF URL 直接将流水管道摄入的 exbf1 517 281 独具特色的非洲文件作为索引。

blocks.en: 3 Data Engineering Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3个 数据工程 管道

blocks.en: Harvesting, validating, and converting hundreds of thousands of academic PDFs over the open internet presents formidable distributed systems and data engineering challenges. We implemented an autonomous, storage-conscious pipeline on remote NVIDIA H200 GPU infrastructure.
blocks.zh: 通过开放的互联网采集、验证和转换数十万个学术PDF系统,提出了巨大的分布式系统和数据工程挑战。 我们在遥远的NVIDIA H200 GPU基础设施上安装了一个自主的、有存储意识的管道。

blocks.en: 3.1 Cross-Source Multi-Key Deduplication
blocks.zh: 3.1 跨源多键复制

blocks.en: Because researchers routinely deposit preprints on arXiv, publish the final version in an academic journal, and upload institutional post-prints to CGSpace, naive aggregation leads to severe data contamination. We built an in-memory deduplication engine performing four sequential verifications: 1. Canonical DOI Normalization: Stripping protocol prefixes and trailing characters, matching against 235,461 known DOIs. 2. Title Slug Normalization: Stripping punctuation, whitespace, and diacritics, matching against 310,760 unique title hashes. 3. Repository Handle Matching: Cross-referencing persistent DSpace and arXiv handles. 4. Binary Hash Verification: Generating SHA-256 signatures for downloaded byte streams. In our live benchmark, this engine executes over extbf2,013,298 lookups per second in sub-microseconds, discarding 145,421 duplicates before any file write occurs.
blocks.zh: 由于研究者通常会在arXiv上存放预印,在学术期刊上发表最终版本,并将机构后印上传到CGSpace,天真汇总会导致严重的数据污染. 我们建造了一个内膜减压引擎,进行四个连续核查: 1. Canonical DOI 正常化: 剥离协议前缀和后缀字符,与已知的235,461 DOIs匹配. 2. 标题Slug规范化: 脱去标点,白空,和二极管,与310,760个独特的标题散列相匹配. 3. 存储器处理匹配:交叉参考持久性DSpace和arXiv控件。 4. 二进制Hash验证:生成SHA-256签名供下载的字节流使用. 在我们的直播基准中,这个引擎在子微秒中每秒执行extbf2,013,298的检查,在任何文件写入之前丢弃145,421的重复.

blocks.en: Canonical DOI Normalization: Stripping protocol prefixes and trailing characters, matching against 235,461 known DOIs.
blocks.zh: 加农科医生 正常化 : 剥离协议前缀和后缀字符,与已知的235,461 DOIs匹配.

blocks.en: Title Slug Normalization: Stripping punctuation, whitespace, and diacritics, matching against 310,760 unique title hashes.
blocks.zh: 标题Slug 正常化 : 脱去标点,白空,和二极管,与310,760个独特的标题散列相匹配.

blocks.en: Repository Handle Matching: Cross-referencing persistent DSpace and arXiv handles.
blocks.zh: 仓库处理 匹配:交叉引用持久DSpace和arXiv手柄.

blocks.en: Binary Hash Verification: Generating SHA-256 signatures for downloaded byte streams.
blocks.zh: 二进制Hash验证:生成SHA-256签名供下载的字节流.

blocks.en: 3.2 Layout-Aware Markdown Extraction
blocks.zh: 3.2 布局- 预告标记提取

blocks.en: Traditional PDF text extractors collapse multi-column text horizontally, interleaving alternating columns into incoherent strings. We employ PyMuPDF layout analysis configured with non-blocking vector parameters ( ignore_images=True, ignore_graphics=True, graphics_limit=200 ) and native block ordering: • Column boundaries are respected, extracting Column 1 top-to-bottom prior to Column 2. • Heading hierarchies ( # , ## ) are derived from font weight and scale. • Tables are parsed into standardized Markdown tabular syntax ( |---|---| ). • Running headers, footers, and page numbers are dynamically identified and stripped via regular expression filters.
blocks.zh: 传统的 PDF 文本提取器横向折叠多列文本,将列交替为不一致的字符串. 我们使用配置在非屏蔽矢量参数(忽略_images=True,忽略_graphics=True,图形_limit=200)的PyMuPDF布局分析,并使用本地块命令: • 列边界得到遵守,在列前从上到下提取列 1 2. 标题等级(#,#)源于字体重量和尺度. • 表解为标准化的Markdown表语法(XQ-------------)。

blocks.en: Column boundaries are respected, extracting Column 1 top-to-bottom prior to Column 2.
blocks.zh: 列边框得到遵守,在列2前自上而下提取列1。

blocks.en: Heading hierarchies ( # , ## ) are derived from font weight and scale.
blocks.zh: 标题等级(#,#)源于字体重量和尺度.

blocks.en: Tables are parsed into standardized Markdown tabular syntax ( |---|---| ).
blocks.zh: 表解为标准化的Markdown表语法( -|-|-|-|-).

blocks.en: Running headers, footers, and page numbers are dynamically identified and stripped via regular expression filters.
blocks.zh: 运行中的页眉,页脚和页码通过正则表达式过滤器被动态识别和剥离.

blocks.en: 3.3 Stream-to-Parquet & Zero-Disk-Bloat Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.3 流到平面和零磁盘-布卢特建筑

blocks.en: Storing 1.75 million raw PDF binaries on disk would require over 2.6 Terabytes of NVMe volume space. To operate sustainably, we architected a extbfStream-to-Parquet pipeline: 1. The PDF is streamed directly into an isolated temporary buffer on high-capacity scratch storage ( /mnt/volume_d2wey28/tmp ). 2. The text is parsed, cleaned, and verified for digital content fidelity ( > 150 >150 characters). 3. The bulky raw PDF is instantly deleted . 4. The clean Markdown text, metadata frontmatter, and BPE token counts are buffered into memory. 5. At exactly 2,000 papers, the batch is flushed to a compressed Parquet shard using zstd compression. Because clean Markdown in compressed Parquet is extbf35x smaller than raw PDF binaries, the entire 1.75-million-paper corpus requires only ∼ \sim 55 Gigabytes of disk storage.
blocks.zh: 将175万个原始PDF二进制存储在磁盘上,需要超过2.6兆字节的NVMe音量空间。 为了可持续运行,我们设计了ExbfStream至Parquet输油管: 1. PDF在大容量刮痕存储(/mnt/world_d2wey28/tmp)上直接流入一个孤立的临时缓冲器. 2. 文字经过解析、清理并核实数字内容是否忠实( > 150 > 150字符)。 3. 大量原始PDF立即删除。 4. 清洁的Markdown文本、元数据前题和BPE令牌计数被缓冲到内存中。 5. 整2 000份纸张用zstd压缩将批量冲到压缩的Parquet shard。 由于压缩 Parquet 中干净的Markdown 的exbf35x比原始的 PDF 二进制小,整个175万纸币只要求\\sim 55 Gigabytes 磁盘存储.

blocks.en: The PDF is streamed directly into an isolated temporary buffer on high-capacity scratch storage ( /mnt/volume_d2wey28/tmp ).
blocks.zh: PDF在高容量刮痕存储器(/mnt/world_d2wey28/tmp)上直接流入一个孤立的临时缓冲器.

blocks.en: The text is parsed, cleaned, and verified for digital content fidelity ( > 150 >150 characters).
blocks.zh: 文本经过解析、清理并核实数字内容是否忠实( > 150 > 150字符)。

blocks.en: The bulky raw PDF is instantly deleted .
blocks.zh: 大量原始PDF立即删除。

blocks.en: The clean Markdown text, metadata frontmatter, and BPE token counts are buffered into memory.
blocks.zh: 干净的Markdown文本,元数据前题,以及BPE符记数被缓冲到内存中.

blocks.en: At exactly 2,000 papers, the batch is flushed to a compressed Parquet shard using zstd compression.
blocks.zh: 整两千张纸, 批量被冲到一个压缩的Parquet shard 使用zstd压缩。

blocks.zh: 图1:非洲-Papers的Markdown代表样本。 每个样本都包含结构化的元数据前题,然后是清洁的线性段形体,准备进行自动回转模型.

blocks.en: 4 Corpus Characteristics & Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 公司特征和分析

blocks.en: 4.1 Domain Distribution
blocks.zh: 4.1 域分布

blocks.en: As detailed in Table 1 , Africa-Papers covers eight standardized academic domains: • Medicine & Public Health (23.9%): Represents the largest single domain (188k papers), providing dense coverage of tropical medicine, clinical epidemiology, maternal health, and infectious disease management across sub-Saharan district health centers. • Social Sciences & Economics (23.1%): Encompasses 182k papers addressing African macroeconomic modeling, regional currency dynamics, trade integration, customary institutions, and educational policy. • Agriculture & Food Security (18.4%): Contains 145k papers and manuals detailing cassava brown streak disease, fall armyworm mitigation, soil nutrient mapping, and agro-pastoral systems. • Engineering & Earth Sciences (15.0%): Captures 118k papers on hydrological modeling, artisanal and industrial mining geology, and renewable grid integration. • Computer Science & AI (9.7%): Features 76k papers, including state-of-the-art African NLP, speech synthesis for tonal languages, and computer vision for crop diagnostics.
blocks.zh: 如表1所详述,非洲保健方案涵盖八个标准化学术领域:医学和公共卫生(23.9%): 代表最大的单一领域(188k纸),在整个撒哈拉以南地区保健中心提供密集的热带医学、临床流行病学、产妇保健和传染病管理。 • 社会科学和经济学(23.1%): 合并 182k篇论文涉及非洲宏观经济模式、区域货币动态、贸易一体化、习惯机构和教育政策。 • 农业和粮食安全(18.4%): 包含145k的论文和手册,详细介绍了木薯棕色螺旋状疾病、降亚虫减缓、土壤养分测绘和农牧系统。 • 工程和地球科学(15.0%): 收集118k篇关于水文建模、手工和工业采矿地质学以及可再生电网一体化的论文。 • 计算机科学与AI(9.7%): 特色论文76k,包括最先进的非洲NLP,对直肠语言的语音合成,以及对作物诊断的计算机视觉.

blocks.en: 4.2 Tokenization & Quantitative Scale
blocks.zh: 4.2 肯化和定量 缩放

blocks.en: We compute exact token statistics using OpenAI’s cl100k_base byte-pair encoding (BPE) tokenizer. Across our empirical validation sample of 100 random papers on H200 compute: • Average Paper Length: 20.2 pages (7,745 words). • Mean Token Count per Paper: 17,214 tokens. • Median Token Count per Paper: 11,536 tokens. • Live Corpus Volume: extbf10.15 Billion tokens across 879 Parquet shards (averaging 35–45 MB per shard).
blocks.zh: 我们使用 OpenAI 的 cl100k_ base 字节-pair 编码器( BPE) 来计算精确的符号统计 。 通过我们关于H200计算100份随机论文的经验验证样本: 平均纸张长度:20.2页(7 745字)。 • 每张纸的平均托肯数:17 214个令牌。 • 每张纸的中位数托肯:11 536个信使。 • 活体体积:extbf10.15 跨越879个 Parquet 硬币(每个硬币为35–45 MB)的亿兆令牌.

blocks.en: 4.3 Linguistic Diversity
blocks.zh: 4.3 语言多样性

blocks.en: While scholarly reporting in STEM domains defaults predominantly to English, Africa-Papers exhibits substantial multilingual diversity. The DOAJ and OpenAlex streams capture significant corpora in extbfFrench (predominant across Senegal, Côte d’Ivoire, Cameroon, and Mali), extbfArabic (extensively represented across Egypt, Algeria, Morocco, and Tunisia), and extbfPortuguese (Angola and Mozambique). Furthermore, thousands of CGSpace farmer leaflets and arXiv speech papers feature parallel text in indigenous African languages, including extbfSwahili, Yoruba, Hausa, Amharic, Twi, and Zulu.
blocks.zh: 虽然STEM域的学术报告主要以英语为主,但非洲-Papers显示出大量的多种语言。 司法部和OpenAlex溪流以特制法语(主要分布在塞内加尔、科特迪瓦、喀麦隆和马里)、特制阿拉伯语(广泛分布在埃及、阿尔及利亚、摩洛哥和突尼斯)和特制葡萄牙语(安哥拉和莫桑比克)捕获了重要的公司。 此外,数千份CGSpace农民传单和arXiv演讲文件还以非洲土著语言提供平行文本,包括exbfSwahili、Yoruba、Hausa、Amharic、Twi和Zulu。

blocks.en: 5 Continual Pre-Training & Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5 连续培训前评估

blocks.en: To validate the utility of Africa-Papers, we outline experimental protocols for Continual Pre-Training (CPT) of open-weights foundation models (e.g., Llama-3-8B and Qwen-2.5-7B).
blocks.zh: 为了验证非洲-Papers的用途,我们概述了开放量级基础模型(如Llama-3-8B和Quen-2.5-7B)的连续预训(CPT)实验协议.

blocks.en: 5.1 Pre-Training Configuration
blocks.zh: 5.1 培训前配置

blocks.en: During domain-adaptive continual pre-training, models are trained on sequence lengths of 8,192 tokens using token packing. Because the median paper length in Africa-Papers is 11,536 tokens, individual papers fit naturally within 1 to 2 packed context windows, preserving long-range cross-section reasoning and bibliography citations without artificial chunk fragmentation.
blocks.zh: 在连续进行域调整前培训期间,对模型进行了使用符号包装的8 192个符号序列长度的培训。 由于非洲-Papers的中位纸张长度为11,536个令牌,因此单个文件自然适合1至2个包装的上下文窗口,保留了远距离横截面推理和参考文献,没有人为块分割。

blocks.en: 5.2 Target Evaluation Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 5.2 目标评价基准

blocks.en: We evaluate domain competence across three specialized benchmarks: 1. African Medical Diagnostic Reasoning: Testing zero-shot and few-shot diagnostic accuracy on tropical clinical case studies where Western-trained baselines frequently recommend inapplicable interventions. 2. Tropical Agro-Ecological QA: Evaluating recommendations for smallholder crop disease management and soil amendment against verified CGIAR protocols. 3. African NLP & Linguistic Benchmarks: Measuring downstream performance on AfriSenti, AfriQA [ 6 ] , and low-resource African machine translation [ 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们评估三个专门基准的域内能力: 1. 非洲医学诊断 理由:在热带临床案例研究中测试零发和几发诊断精度,而西方训练的基线往往建议采取不适用的干预措施。 2. 热带农业生态学 质量评估:评价关于小农作物疾病管理和土壤改良的建议,以参照经核实的农业研究组议定书。 3. 非洲NLP和语言 基准: 测量AfriSenti,AfriQA[6]和低资源非洲机器翻译的下游性能[5].

blocks.en: 6 Ethical Considerations & Open Access
blocks.zh: 6 伦理考虑和开放访问

blocks.en: All publications included in Africa-Papers are harvested strictly from verified open-access channels under permissive licensing (predominantly Creative Commons Attribution, CC BY 4.0). Every sample retains full bibliographic attribution, including author names, institutional affiliations, original publisher, and canonical DOI links. By providing structured domain partitions, we ensure researchers can filter or subset data according to institutional review standards.
blocks.zh: 所有列入非洲期刊的出版物都严格通过经核查的开放渠道获得许可(主要是《创用CC BY 4.0》)。 每个样本都保留了完整的书目归属,包括作者姓名,机构隶属关系,原出版商,以及cononical DOI链接. 通过提供结构化域分区,我们确保研究人员可以根据机构审查标准过滤或分集数据.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Africa-Papers addresses one of the most critical representation divides in modern artificial intelligence. By assembling extbf844,807 full-text papers and extbf10.15 billion tokens into a clean, layout-aware Markdown corpus, we provide the global AI community with the foundational data necessary to train models that understand and respect African scientific, medical, and agricultural knowledge. The complete corpus is available for research on Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/AfriSpeech/africa-papers .
blocks.zh: 非洲-Papers处理现代人工智能中最关键的代表性鸿沟之一。 通过将exbf844,807份全文文件和exbf101.5亿令牌汇编成一个干净的、有布局意识的Markdown程序,我们向全球AI社区提供了培训了解和尊重非洲科学、医疗和农业知识的模型所必需的基础数据。 在https://huggingface.co/datasets/AfriSpeech/Africa-papers上,可以查阅完整资料汇编。
